_comment: The dispatcher's lines (Tools/Audio/fto_synth.py voices them as SW_Dispatch_<Category>_NN and writes Source/FTO/Audio/FTODispatchLines.inl for the subtitles).
ShiftStart: Morning, officers. Try not to break anything today.
Dispatch here. The city's still standing. Let's keep it that way, shall we?
Shift's on. Coffee's cold. Off you go.
SetPiece: All units, something big. Try to look professional.
This is the big one, officers. No pressure. Lots of pressure.
RushHour: Rush hour. Good luck. You'll need it.
Two minutes left and the phones won't stop. Lovely.
ChaosHigh: Chaos is through the roof. Is anyone actually working?
The mayor's on line two. He's crying.
I can see the smoke from here, officers.
CallFailed: That call went cold. Like my coffee.
Missed it. I'll put that in the report. In capitals.
BigBust: Nice bust. Don't let it go to your head.
Oh look, competence. Somebody write that down.
Well, well. Somebody's getting a sticker.
Oops: That was a pedestrian, not a speed bump.
You arrested someone for standing there. Bold choice.
Please stop hurting the citizens. Think of the paperwork.
NewCall: New call on the board. It won't arrest itself.
Another one for you. Try to look busy.
Fresh call coming in. Somebody, anybody, please.
Arrest: Cuffs on. Look at you go.
One in the bag. Only a whole city to go.
Booked: Another guest for the cells. I'll fluff the pillows.
Booked and filed. The paperwork's on your desk.
Teamwork: Teamwork! I didn't know you lot could do that.
Look at you, working together. I'm almost proud.
Idle: Officers, the crimes won't solve themselves. Allegedly.
Is everyone on a donut break? All of you? At once?
Survived: Shift's over. Not bad. For you.
Clock off, officers. The city survived. Barely.
Overrun: The city has fallen. I'm updating my CV.
Well. That happened. Go home, everyone.
